لتقليل استهلاك السيارة: حافظ على ضغط الإ: To reduce your car's consumption: keep tyres at the correct pressure (under-inflated tyres noticeably increase consumption), avoid sudden acceleration and braking, remove extra weight and the roof rack if you are not using it, combine several short errands into one trip instead of repeatedly starting a cold engine, and keep up regular maintenance of the engine and air filter — all of this affects fuel consumption more than many drivers expect.
